lines.t: There is sacred vow one has to make
When getting married to their chosen mate.
Perfect vessels from the Lord
To unite these two in one accord.
Chorus
Husband and wife they'll forever be,
To form a bond in their family tree,
Now filled with His love that will never depart,
For God sealed them together in His loving heart.
Bridge
And crown them with blessings
To have many offsprings
And complete His plan
That He's made for man—
A holy union made by God's hand
